ci.bounds: the wider of the cluster bootstrap and the item-level Wilson interval

example_line: org prompt "... The blue locker belongs to the bear. ... The red locker belongs to the chicken. ... The grey locker belongs to the spider. ... Which colour is the locker that belongs to the animal known for clucking?" -> answer org red; the alt prompt asks about the spider (bridge alt), its 1st statement. Possible answers after the patch: grey (answer of bridge alt's statement), blue (answer at the same statement slot), purple (the alt prompt's own answer), red (answer org kept).

example_lines.e8-digit: org prompt "... The file on Hungary is kept in drawer 0. ... The file on Japan is kept in drawer 9. ... The file on Thailand is kept in drawer 8. ... What drawer keeps the file on the country whose capital is Bangkok?" -> answer org 8; the alt prompt asks about the Japan (bridge alt), its 3rd statement. Possible answers after the patch: 9 (answer of bridge alt's statement), 0 (answer at the same statement slot), 5 (the alt prompt's own answer), 8 (answer org kept).
